# MAËLYS

## Brand Identity
MAËLYS is a premium luxury fragrance house founded in Paris, specializing in artisanal perfumes crafted from the finest ingredients sourced from Grasse, France. Each fragrance is a unique olfactory journey, blending tradition with modern sophistication.

- ÉTERNELLE: A timeless chypre with oakmoss, iris, and patchouli. 50ml — €210.
- SÉRÉNE: A calming aquatic scent of sea salt, driftwood, and white musk. 50ml — €165.
- VELOURS: A rich, powdery violet with heliotrope, tonka bean, and suede. 50ml — €190.
- AURORA: A fresh, dewy morning fragrance of dew-kissed rose, fig leaf, and cedar. 50ml — €180.

## Collections
- Les Classiques: Timeless, elegant fragrances for every occasion.
- Les Nocturnes: Deep, seductive scents for evening and special moments.
- Les Florales: Floral-forward compositions celebrating nature's beauty.
- Les Boisées: Warm, woody fragrances with earthy sophistication.

## Policies
- Shipping: Free express shipping on all orders over €100. Standard delivery 2-4 business days. Express next-day delivery available.
- Returns: 30-day return window for unopened products. Personalized items are final sale.
- Privacy: GDPR-compliant data handling. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
- Terms: All purchases subject to our terms of service. Prices in EUR. VAT included.
